summary: Completed comprehensive testing of blob-based label image preview fix on Employee Orders page. All backend API tests passed (6/6). All frontend UI tests passed - blob-based fetch approach works correctly, images load with naturalWidth > 0, multiple labels can be expanded simultaneously, eye icons show blue highlight when active, display names shown instead of raw filenames.
critical_code_review_comments: fetchLabelPreview() correctly uses fetch() -> blob -> createObjectURL() pattern (lines 36-47 in OrdersPage.jsx)
labelPreviews state stores blob URLs keyed by label ID for caching
toggleLabelPreview() correctly manages expandedLabels Set for multi-expand support
Loading spinner (Loader2) shows while blob is being fetched, replaced by img when ready
Eye button styling correctly changes to text-[#00D4FF] bg-[#00D4FF]/10 when expanded
Both matched labels section (lines 374-384) and unmatched labels section (lines 436-448) use same blob-based approach
display_name shown instead of raw filename (line 345: linked.label.display_name || linked.label.filename)
Token correctly passed as query param: /api/orders/labels/{id}/preview?token={jwt}
seed_data_creation: Used existing assignment with 83 items, 5 labels, 5 matches
